name: Neraph
printedArtCredit: David Roach, generic Neraph p. 12. Vinod Rams, Cado throwing an annulat, p. 48.
sourceDistinctions: The racial charge and thrown options share a single use per enemy per encounter. The optional feat entries are separate.
An annulat reduces the existing cover bonus by two for a proficient user. It adds no general bonus against uncovered targets.
The PC rules describe a Limbo-origin Outsider who is Extraplanar away from home. The sample Cado block lists Native. The staged encounters use the PC traits on the Material Plane.
portraitForm: Teo Spent River, an original Neraph Ranger
